explanation: Sort a copy, select each possible first value and search the remaining target with two pointers. Equal indices are permitted because the existing EPI contract allows an input element to be reused. A wide intermediate avoids overflow while adding the three values.
spaceComplexity: O(n) copied array space, plus sorting stack.
attribution: Original C++ implementation and explanation authored for EPI Practice from the displayed problem contract and repository-authored C# algorithms. Uses the existing local native test-framework API. No upstream reference implementation was altered or translated.
